spots.name: Basilica of Notre-Dame de Fourvière
spots.summary: The Basilica of Notre-Dame de Fourvière is a minor basilica in Lyon, France. It was built with private funds between 1872 and 1896 in a dominant position overlooking the city. The site it occupies was once the Roman forum of Trajan, the forum vetus, thus its name.

names.ja: ノートルダム大聖堂 (フルヴィエール)

spots.name: Lyon Cathedral
spots.summary: Lyon Cathedral or the Cathedral of Saint John the Baptist of Lyon is a Roman Catholic church located on Place Saint-Jean in central Lyon, France. The cathedral is dedicated to Saint John the Baptist, and is the seat of the Archbishop of Lyon. Begun in 1180 on the ruins of a 6th-century church, it was completed in 1476.

spots.name: Museum of Fine Arts of Lyon

hours.note: Closed Tue, Fri

spots.summary: The Museum of Fine Arts of Lyon is a municipal museum of fine arts in the French city of Lyon. Located near the Place des Terreaux, it is housed in a former Benedictine convent which was active during the 17th and 18th centuries.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Museum of Fine Arts of Lyon

names.es: Museo de Bellas Artes de Lyon
names.it: Museo di belle arti di Lione

spots.name: Fontaine Bartholdi
spots.summary: The Fontaine Bartholdi is a fountain sculpted by Frédéric Auguste Bartholdi and realised in 1889 by Gaget & Gautier. It was erected at the Place des Terreaux, in the 1st arrondissement of Lyon, in September 1892.

spots.name: Place Bellecour
spots.summary: The Place Bellecour is a large square in the centre of Lyon, France, to the north of the Ainay district. Measuring 312 m by 200 m, it is one of the largest open squares in Europe, and the third biggest square in France, behind the Place des Quinconces in Bordeaux (12.6 ha) and the Place de la Concorde in Paris (8.6 ha).

spots.name: Stade de Gerland
spots.summary: The Stade de Gerland is a stadium in the city of Lyon, France, which serves as home to Top 14 rugby club Lyon OU. It has a seating capacity of 35,029.

names.ja: スタッド・ジェルラン

spots.name: Hôtel-Dieu de Lyon

hours.note: Closed Sun

spots.summary: The Hôtel-Dieu de Lyon was a hospital of historical significance situated on the right bank of the Rhône river in Lyon, on the Presqu'île. It has been out of use since 2010.

spots.name: Lugdunum

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Lugdunum was an important Roman city in Gaul, established on the current site of Lyon.

spots.name: Place des Terreaux
spots.summary: The Place des Terreaux is a square located in the centre of Lyon, France, on the Presqu'île between the Rhône and the Saône rivers, at the foot of the hill of La Croix-Rousse in the 1st arrondissement. It borders both the Hôtel de Ville and Musée des Beaux-Arts de Lyon.

spots.name: Tour Part-Dieu

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Tour Part-Dieu is a skyscraper in Lyon, France. The building is 164.9 metres (541 ft) tall, in La Part-Dieu district, with 42 floors. The building was completed in 1977. It currently stands as the thirteenth-tallest building in France and is the tallest outside of Paris.

spots.name: Parc de la Tête d'or
spots.summary: The Parc de la Tête d'Or is the largest urban park in Lyon, France, with an area of approximately 117 hectares. Located in the northern part of its 6th arrondissement, it features the Jardin botanique de Lyon, as well as a lake on which boating takes place during the summer months.

spots.name: Vieux Lyon
spots.summary: Vieux Lyon is the largest Renaissance district of Lyon. In 1964, Vieux-Lyon, the city's oldest district, became the first site in France to be protected under the Malraux law to protect France's cultural sites.

spots.name: Hôtel de Ville, Lyon
spots.summary: The Hôtel de Ville is the city hall of Lyon, France, and one of the largest historic buildings in the city. The building is located between the Place des Terreaux and the Place de la Comédie, in front of the Opéra Nouvel. It was designated a monument historique by the French government in 1886.

spots.name: Tour Incity

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Tour Incity is an office skyscraper in the La Part-Dieu district of Lyon, France. Built between 2013 and 2015, the tower stands at 200 m (660 ft) tall with 39 floors, and is the tallest building in the Greater Lyon area as well as the fifth tallest building in France.

spots.name: Musée des Confluences

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Musée des Confluences is a science centre and anthropology museum which opened on 20 December 2014, in the 2nd arrondissement of Lyon (Rhône), France.

spots.name: Metallic tower of Fourvière

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Tour métallique de Fourvière, a landmark of Lyon, France, is a steel framework tower which bears a striking resemblance to the Eiffel Tower, which predates it by three years.

spots.name: La Croix-Rousse
spots.summary: La Croix-Rousse is a hill 254 metres (833 ft) high in the city of Lyon, France, as well as the name of a neighborhood located on this hill. The neighborhood is divided into les pentes and le plateau. This zone is served by Lyon Metro Line C.

spots.name: Saint-Nizier Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Church of Saint-Nizier is a church in the Presqu'île district of Lyon, France, in the 2nd arrondissement, between the Place des Terreaux and the Place des Jacobins. Its name refers to Nicetius of Lyon, a bishop of the city during the 6th century.

spots.name: Basilica of Saint-Martin d'Ainay
spots.summary: The Basilica of Saint-Martin d'Ainay is a Romanesque church in Ainay in the Presqu'île district in the historic centre of Lyon, France.

names.es: Basílica de San Martín de Ainay

spots.name: Tour To-Lyon

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Tour To-Lyon is a mixed-use skyscraper in the La Part-Dieu business district of Lyon, France. The building include 66,000 m2 of office space, 10,500 m2 of hotel space and 3,500 m2 of retail space. With a height of 170 m, it became the second-tallest skyscraper in Lyon after Tour Incity completed in 2015.

spots.name: Tour Oxygène

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Tour Oxygène is a skyscraper which rises 28 levels in the district of La Part-Dieu in the 3rd arrondissement of Lyon, France. It forms part of the Oxygen Project, which includes the office tower and a shopping center, the Cours Oxygène. The tower rises 115 meters high.

spots.name: Église Saint-Bonaventure

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Église Saint-Bonaventure is one of the churches of the quarter Presqu'île, located on the Place des Cordeliers, in the 2nd arrondissement of Lyon. This is the only medieval building not demolished after the creation of the rue Impériale, under the Second Empire by the prefect Claude-Marius Vaïsse.

spots.name: ancient theatre of Lyon

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Ancient Theatre of Fourvière is a Roman theatre in Lyon, France. It was built on the hill of Fourvière, which is situated in the center of the Roman city. The theatre is part of a UNESCO World Heritage Site that protects the historic center of Lyon.

spots.name: Aqueduct of the Gier

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Aqueduct of the Gier is an ancient Roman aqueduct probably constructed in the 1st century AD to provide water for Lugdunum (Lyon), in what is now eastern France. It is the longest and best preserved of four Roman aqueducts that served the growing capital of the Roman province of Gallia Lugdunensis.

spots.name: Rue de la République
spots.summary: The Rue de la République is a street located in the 1st and 2nd arrondissements of Lyon, France. It links the Place de la Comédie in the north to the Place Le Viste in the south, just next to the Place Bellecour, via the Place de la République.

spots.name: Montluc prison
spots.summary: Montluc prison is a former prison located on rue Jeanne Hachette in the 3rd arrondissement of Lyon, France. It was known for being an internment, torture and killing place by the Gestapo during the occupation of France by Nazi Germany.

photo.author: This picture belongs to Xavier Caré. Please credit : Xavier Caré / Wikimedia Com

spots.name: Lycée du Parc
spots.summary: The Lycée du Parc is a public secondary school located in the sixth arrondissement of Lyon, France. Its name comes from the Parc de la Tête d'Or, one of Europe's largest urban parks, which is situated nearby.

spots.name: Palais Saint-Pierre
spots.summary: The Abbey of Saint-Pierre-les-Nonnains in Lyon, also known as the Abbey of the Dames de Saint-Pierre or simply Palais Saint-Pierre, is an ancient Catholic religious edifice that housed Benedictine nuns from the 10th century onwards, and was rebuilt in the 17th century.

spots.name: Church of Saint-Bruno des Chartreux

hours.note: Closed Sun

spots.summary: The Church of Saint-Bruno des Chartreux is a Roman Catholic church located in Lyon, France. Until the French Revolution, it was the church of Lyon Charterhouse. The cathedral is dedicated to Saint Bruno of Cologne, also known as Saint Bruno of the Carthusians, and is the city's only Baroque church.

names.it: Chiesa di San Bruno della Certosa

photo.author: No machine-readable author provided. Digne~commonswiki assumed (based on copyrig

spots.name: Saint Irenaeus Church, Lyon
spots.summary: The Saint Irenaeus Church, Lyon, located on the heights of Lyon in the neighborhood of St. Irenaeus, is one of the oldest churches in France. It is named for Irenaeus first Bishop of Lyon and Primate of Gaul.

spots.name: Place des Jacobins
spots.summary: The Place des Jacobins is a square located in the 2nd arrondissement of Lyon. It was created in 1556 and a fountain was added in 1856. The square belongs to the zone classified as World Heritage Site by UNESCO.

spots.name: Place Carnot
spots.summary: The Place Carnot is a square located in the Perrache quarter, in the 2nd arrondissement of Lyon.

spots.name: amphitheater of Lyon

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Amphitheatre of the Three Gauls of Lugdunum (Lyon) was part of the Sanctuary of the Three Gauls dedicated to the cult of Rome and Augustus celebrated by the 60 Gallic tribes when they gathered at Lugdunum. In 1961, it was classified as a monument historique.

spots.name: Palais de la Bourse
spots.summary: The Palais de la Bourse or Palais du Commerce is a building in the Les Cordeliers quarter in 2nd arrondissement of Lyon. It currently houses the headquarters of the Chamber of Commerce and Industry (CCI) of Lyon. In 1994, the building was classified a monument historique.

spots.name: Église Saint-Paul

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Église Saint-Paul is a Roman Catholic church located in Lyon, France. It is situated in the Vieux Lyon, in the Saint-Paul quarter, in the 5th arrondissement of Lyon. The cathedral is in the Romanesque and Gothic architectural styles.

spots.name: Musée Gadagne

hours.note: Closed Mon, Tue

spots.summary: The Musée Gadagne is a museum located in the center of the Vieux Lyon, in the Saint-Jean quarter, in the 5th arrondissement of Lyon, France. It is composed of the Musée d'Histoire de Lyon and the Musée des Marionnettes du monde. The building was classified as a historic monument in 1920.

spots.name: Opéra de Lyon
spots.summary: The Opéra de Lyon in Lyon, France, is the home of the Opéra National de Lyon. The original opera house was re-designed by the distinguished French architect, Jean Nouvel between 1985 and 1993 in association with the agency of scenography dUCKS scéno and the acoustician Peutz.

spots.name: Église Saint-Georges

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Église Saint-Georges is a Roman Catholic church located on the Place François-Bertras, in the Vieux Lyon quarter, in the 5th arrondissement of Lyon. It is under the direction of the Primatiale parish and was named in honor of Saint George.

spots.name: Institut Lumière

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Institut Lumière is a French organisation, based in Lyon, for the promotion and preservation of aspects of French film making. The Institut Lumière is a museum that honours the contribution to filmmaking by Auguste and Louis Lumière, inventors of the cinématographe and fathers of the cinema.

spots.name: Manécanterie

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Manécanterie is an ancient monument situated in Lyon in Saint Jean district, in the 5th arrondissement of Lyon. It is placed side by side to the south southwest of the cathedral Saint Jean and is a part of the former convent of the cathedral.

spots.name: Collège-lycée Ampère
spots.summary: The Collège-lycée Ampère is a school located in the 2nd arrondissement of Lyon.

names.ja: アンペール中学校・高等学校

spots.name: Loyasse Cemetery
spots.summary: Loyasse Cemetery is a cemetery in the city of Lyon, France. The cemetery is located on the Fourvière hill in the western part of the city, not far away from the Metallic tower of Fourvière and Notre-Dame de Fourvière.

spots.name: Rue Sainte-Catherine
spots.summary: The Rue Sainte-Catherine is a very old street at the foot of the slopes of La Croix-Rousse quarter, in the 1st arrondissement of Lyon. It is particularly known for being a drinking street. The street belongs to the zone classified as World Heritage Site by UNESCO.

spots.name: Place Sathonay
spots.summary: The Place Sathonay is a square located in the 1st arrondissement of Lyon, France, at the bottom of hill of La Croix-Rousse, in La Martinière quarter. It was named after Nicolas-Marie-Jean-Claude Fay de Sathonay, mayor of Lyon from 1805 to 1812, as a tribute for all the importants works undertaken under his presidency.

spots.name: Église du Bon-Pasteur

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Église du Bon-Pasteur is a Roman Catholic church located at rue Neyret on the slopes of La Croix-Rousse, near the montée de la Grande Côte, in the 1st arrondissement of Lyon. Cardinal Barbarin described the church as "highly symbolic for Lyon Christians".

spots.name: Sanctuary of the Three Gauls

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Sanctuary of the Three Gauls (Tres Galliae) (French: Sanctuaire fédéral des Trois Gaules) was the focal structure within an administrative and religious complex established by Rome in the very late 1st century BC at Lugdunum (the site of modern Lyon in France).

names.es: Santuario federal de las tres Galias

spots.name: Montée de la Grande Côte
spots.summary: The Montée de la Grande Côte, or the Montée de la Grande-Côte, is a street of La Croix-Rousse quarter, in the 1st arrondissement of Lyon, which connects the Terreaux quarter and the Plateau de la Croix Rousse. It is characterized by a high elevation and is more narrow at the bottom.

spots.name: Chapelle Saint-Thomas
spots.summary: The small museum holds treasures donated to the church for its construction.

spots.name: Place Saint-Jean
spots.summary: The Place Saint-Jean is an old pedestrian square in the 5th arrondissement of Lyon. It is located in front of the Roman Catholic cathedral of Saint-Jean.

spots.name: Temple du Change

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Temple du Change or Loge du Change, formerly used for the stock exchange of Lyon, stands in Vieux Lyon. It was originally built after plans by architect Simon Gourdet between 1631 and 1653, then rebuilt under the direction of Jacques-Germain Soufflot in 1748–1750.

spots.name: Jardin Rosa Mir

hours.note: Closed Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sun

spots.summary: The Jardin Rosa Mir is a garden located in the center of La Croix-Rousse quarter in the 4th arrondissement of Lyon, and created by Jules Senis. It is housed in a courtyard of the building at No. 83 Grande Rue de la Croix-Rousse. It can be accessed through a path located at No. 87 in the same street.

spots.name: La Sucrière

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: La Sucrière is a building devoted to contemporary art, situated 48 Quai Rambaud, on the banks of the Saône in the Confluence quarter of the 2nd arrondissement of Lyon.

spots.name: Église Saint-Polycarpe

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Église Saint-Polycarpe is a Roman Catholic church located in the 1st arrondissement of Lyon, on the slopes of La Croix-Rousse, between rue René Leynaud, rue Burdeau and passages Mermet and Thiaffait. It is the oldest church of the Oratory of Saint Philip Neri.

spots.name: Théâtre des Célestins
spots.summary: The Théâtre des Célestins is a theatre building on the Place des Célestins in Lyon, France. It was designed by Gaspard André, and inaugurated in 1877, then again in 2005. Alongside the Comédie-Française and the Théâtre de l'Odéon, it is one of few theatres with over 200 years' continual usage in France.

spots.name: Bibliothèque municipale de Lyon
spots.summary: The Bibliothèque municipale de Lyon is a historically significant library in Lyon, France.

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.name: Centre d'histoire de la résistance et de la déportation

hours.note: Closed Mon, Tue, Sun

spots.summary: The Centre d'histoire de la résistance et de la déportation is a museum in Lyon, France.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Centre d'histoire de la résistance et de la déportation

names.es: Centro de historia de la Resistencia y la Deportación

names.zh: 抵抗运动史和流放史中心

spots.name: Abode of Chaos

hours.note: Closed Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri

spots.summary: The Abode of Chaos is a contemporary art museum located in Saint-Romain-au-Mont-d'Or, a small town in the vicinity of Lyon, France, with over 2,500 works from many different artists, including the owner Thierry Ehrmann.

spots.name: Jardin botanique de Lyon
spots.summary: The Jardin botanique de Lyon, also known as the Jardin botanique du Parc de la Tête d'Or, is an 8 hectares municipal botanical garden located in the Parc de la Tête d'or in the 6th arrondissement of Lyon, France. It is open weekdays without charge.

spots.name: Musée Miniature et Cinéma
spots.summary: Created by artist Dan Ohlmann, this private gallery shows about 120 miniature models of all kinds of scenes: houses, restaurants, workshops, schools, etc., from Lyon or elsewhere, historical or contemporary. The accuracy of the models is astonishing and some sections will be real fun for children. Movie sceneries, models, costumes, masks and props are also presented, including a wand from the Harr

spots.name: Esplanade de Fourvière
spots.summary: Next to the basilica is the panoramic viewpoint, with the best view over the city. If the weather is clear, Mont Blanc can be seen in the distance. This is a very good point to start your visit of the city because you can really see its general layout.

spots.name: Boat trips on the Saône

hours.note: Closed Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu

spots.summary: A boat trip can be a good way to see Lyon from a different point of view. Boats will take you either upstream to Ile Barbe or downstream to the Confluence. Night trips available on Fridays and Saturdays.

spots.name: Montée du Gourguillon
spots.summary: This picturesque montée (sloping street on hillside) starts behind Vieux Lyon metro station and ends quite close to the Roman theatres of Fourvière. It was the main link between the river Saône and the top of Fourvière throughout the Roman era, Middle Ages and Renaissance. Nowadays it keeps a medieval spirit. Around numbers 5-7 is Impasse Turquet, a small cul-de-sac named after Etienne Turquet, an

spots.name: Mur des Lyonnais
spots.summary: This impressive painted wall portraits some of the most famous people who were born in Lyon, from Renaissance poet Louise Labé to the Lumière brothers, the inventors of cinema, to chef Paul Bocuse.

spots.name: Cité Internationale
spots.summary: This business and residential area in an important urban project for Lyon. Designed by the famous Italian architect Renzo Piano (also known for Beaubourg modern art centre in Paris and part of the Potsdamer Platz area in Berlin), it comprises a convention centre, hotels and luxury apartments just between the Rhône and Parc de la Tête d'Or.

spots.name: Mur des Canuts
spots.summary: This painted wall is dedicated to the history and typical architecture of the Croix-Rousse hill.

spots.name: Au 14 Février

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: If you can book at least two months in advance and are ready for a "surprise" menu, this tiny place (16 seats!) run by Japanese chef Tsuyoshi Arai is a rather unique experience. Just tell your waiter what you don't like or can't eat, and you will be served a five- or nine-course menu that changes every day. The cuisine is French with Japanese hints, amazingly creative, and most importantly delicio

spots.name: Brasserie Georges
spots.summary: An exceptional traditional brasserie, serving both traditional Lyonnaise food as well as Alsatian favorites like the Choucroute Impériale, a huge pile of sauerkraut with various sausages and an entire pork knuckle. The cavernous main dining hall is a real Art Deco treat. Founded in 1836, this is one of the largest brasseries in France and it can serve 1000 people a night over two sittings. Reserva

spots.name: Têtedoie

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: A new address for a well-recognized chef. The previous restaurant had a classic dining room on the banks of the Saône. Têtedoie is now taking his restaurant to the next level with a prestigious location offering one of the best views in town and a very contemporary decor, with the same culinary spirit and prices. The wine list is so big they have to carry it around on a trolley. The place also fea

spots.name: Prairial

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Modern, inventive Michelin-starred haute cuisine, served only as a degustation set menu: the 5-course "Confluence" (€99, lunch only) or the full 8-course "Prairial" (€135). Expect local, seasonal produce, heavy on vegetables and seafood and light on meat, with amazing sauces often made from fermented ingredients. Reservations essential. Dinner seatings W-Su at 20:00, lunch F Sa at 12:00.

spots.name: Paul Bocuse

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The home base of the master of all chefs, "Monsieur Paul", this restaurant held 3 Michelin stars for a record 55 years, dropping to two only after his death in 2018. Classic French cuisine, with an extortionate price tag; by all accounts the food remains very good, but there are definitely cheaper options around.

names.ja: ローベルジュ・ドゥ・ポン・ド・コローニュ

spots.name: Balthaz'Art

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Croix-Rousse has more and more interesting restaurants, and this one is a fine example. In a "flea-market-meets-art-gallery" decor, you will enjoy a fresh and creative cuisine with Mediterranean and Asian influences. Nice wine list, and it is still possible to get a table at a relatively short notice.

spots.name: Taco Taco

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Very good and a big variety of tacos, burritos and quesadillas as well as toppings and sauces to choose from ranging from mild to spicy. Everything is freshly prepared in front of the customer. The burritos are different than from the big Mexican fast food chains and as it is more authentic here.

spots.name: La Mère Brazier — Mathieu Viannay

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The restaurant, opened in 1921 by the legendary Eugénie Brazier, was taken over by the talented young chef Mathieu Viannay and awarded 2 stars by the Michelin guide only a few months after its opening. Revisited all-time classics (Bresse poultry with truffles, artichokes with foie gras).

spots.name: L'Art et la Manière

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Small no-tourist restaurant in a no-tourist area. Friendly yet professional service, short menu but very creative, high-quality cooking. Good (although short) wine list. The best bottles are at amazingly low prices given their "constant mark-up" policy.

spots.name: La Piazzetta

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Nice setting on the banks of the Saône, the owner's cooking is a delight. Like a trip to Italy. Quality ingredients, the pastas and pizzas are excellent and the portions generous. Fresh products decorate the pasta and pizzas according to the seasons.

spots.name: Le Potager des Halles

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: This restaurant serves traditional French cuisine made from very good and very fresh products, with a Mediterranean influence. The chocolate fondant dessert is amazing. Very good wine list too. The lunch menu is an absolute steal.

spots.name: Boulangerie Chez Jules St Paul

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Small boulangerie near the historic centre with a great variety of breads, cakes, sandwiches, pizza, salads. There is also the possibility to sit down. Very good croissant aux almond. Also nice to have breakfast. Warm welcome.

spots.name: Kelly's Pub
spots.summary: Irish pub, live music on Saturday, Irish music sessions on Thursday, quiz every Monday, pool, darts, Irish and English pub food, air conditioning.

spots.name: L'Abreuvoir
spots.summary: There you can join some crazy French listening to crazy French music. Definitely an experience, though not everyone's cup of tea.

spots.name: Paddy's Corner
spots.summary: Perfect little pub in the Croix-Rousse area, off the beaten track. Live music sessions every Thursday, Pub Quiz on Tuesdays.

spots.name: Wallace
spots.summary: Comfortable beer and whisky bar with a nice terrace, live sports, pub quiz on Thursdays.

spots.name: Hot Club de Lyon

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Jazz club (since 1948), in an old typical cellar, with good live jazz 5 nights/week.

spots.name: Johnny Walsh's

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: Nice, authentic Irish pub with good music and some live performances.

spots.name: The Smoking Dog

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: English pub. Pub quiz on Tuesdays. Air conditioning.
